title: precheck shows conflict predictions from any external predictor beside its own file overlaps
goal: backlog.py precheck SP --conflicts FILE|- reads JSON lines {"items": [two branches or item ids], "path": P, "kind": "textual" or "semantic"} from any conflict predictor and prints each beside precheck's own overlap of planned files, naming the items by title and id; a line naming an item outside the sprint is listed apart; the contract is documented in backlog.md with no product named; precheck without --conflicts prints what it prints now.

run:
import json,os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();T=os.path.abspath('_tools/backlog.py')
g=lambda *a:s.run(['git','-C',D,*a],capture_output=True,text=True)
g('init','-q');open(os.path.join(D,'backlog.json'),'w').write(json.dumps({'item_dir':'items'}))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(D,'items'));open(os.path.join(D,'a.py'),'w').write('x=1'+chr(10));open(os.path.join(D,'b.py'),'w').write('y=1'+chr(10))
g('add','.');g('-c','user.name=c','-c','user.email=c@example.com','commit','-qm','i')
def bl(*a):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,'--root',D,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300);return p
def new_id(p):
    m=re.findall(r'\b(?:SP|ST|BG)-[a-z0-9]{8}\b',p.stdout+p.stderr);return m[0] if m else None
sp=new_id(bl('new','sprint','--title','Planted sprint','--goal','Two planted stories land'))
F='python3 -c "import sys;sys.exit(1)"'
a=new_id(bl('new','story','--title','Alpha change','--goal','alpha changes a.py','--sprint',sp,'--touch','a.py','--check',F))
b=new_id(bl('new','story','--title','Beta change','--goal','beta changes b.py','--sprint',sp,'--touch','b.py','--check',F))
o=new_id(bl('new','story','--title','Outside change','--goal','outside changes b.py','--touch','b.py','--check',F))
print('ids',sp,a,b,o)

cf=os.path.join(D,'conflicts.jsonl')
open(cf,'w').write(json.dumps({'items':[a,b],'path':'shared.py','kind':'semantic'})+chr(10)+json.dumps({'items':[b,o],'path':'b.py','kind':'textual'})+chr(10))
p=bl('precheck',sp,'--conflicts',cf);print(p.returncode,p.stdout[-1500:],p.stderr[-300:])
L=p.stdout.splitlines()
inn=[k for k,l in enumerate(L) if a in l and b in l and 'Alpha change' in l and 'Beta change' in l and 'shared.py' in l and 'semantic' in l]
out=[k for k,l in enumerate(L) if o in l and 'b.py' in l]
apart=bool(out) and ('outside' in L[out[0]].lower() or any('outside' in L[k].lower() for k in range(out[0]) if not (inn and k<=inn[0])))
ok=p.returncode==0 and bool(inn) and 'outside' not in L[inn[0]].lower() and apart
print('in-sprint line',inn,'outside line',out,'apart',apart);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
